def glom(target, spec, **kwargs):
    scope = kwargs.pop('scope', _DEFAULT_SCOPE)
    if kwargs:
        raise TypeError('glom() got unexpected keyword arguments: %r' % list(kwargs.keys()))
    return scope[glom](target, spec, scope)


def chain_child(scope):
    # create a new child scope that inherits from the parent
    # but has its own path
    parent = scope
    pmap = parent.maps[0]
    scope = parent.new_child({
        Path: pmap[Path] + [pmap[Spec]],
        T: pmap[T],
        Spec: pmap[Spec],
        UP: parent,
        CHILD_ERRORS: [],
        MODE: pmap[MODE],
        MIN_MODE: pmap[MIN_MODE],
    })
    pmap[LAST_CHILD_SCOPE] = scope
    return scope
